db_type.description: Database type. Either 'mysql' for MySQL or 'pgsql' for PostgreSQL.

db_host.description: Database host or absolute Unix socket path.

db_port.description: Database port. By default, the MySQL or PostgreSQL port, depending on the database type.

redis_host.description: Redis host name or address, or absolute Unix socket path.

log_interval.description: Interval for periodic logging defined as duration string.

retention_interval.description: Interval for periodically cleaning up the historical data.

retention_count.description: Number of old historical entries a single query can delete.
